subject: HyperBridge discovery recap + next-step milestone plan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@hyperbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: HyperBridge discovery recap + next-step milestone plan

Hi Santiago — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed mutual action plan so we don’t lose momentum.

Key pain and goals you confirmed:
- Latency spikes on inference during peak retail hours (page loads and checkout) causing measurable drop-offs.
- Cost unpredictability for experiments across GPU families; finance wants a clearer unit cost picture.
- Need VPC/private deployment for PII processing in the EU later this year.

Primary objectives we agreed on:
1) Stabilize tail latency to <150ms 95th within pilot scope.
2) Produce a cost-per-concurrent-session estimate for your busiest SKU mix.
3) Validate private deployment workflow for PII with your security team.

Proposed milestones (first draft):
- Milestone A — Pilot scope & test data: due 2027-04-08 (owner: HyperBridge - Santiago + internal: Jasmine Liu)
- Milestone B — Pilot deploy on Redwood Dedicated (non-production): target 2027-04-22 (owner: Redwood - Ben Carter)
- Milestone C — Latency & cost baseline run (2-week window): 2027-04-24 to 2027-05-07 (owner: HyperBridge eng team / Redwood SE support)
- Milestone D — Security review for private deployment (evidence pack): 2027-05-15 (owner: HyperBridge security / Redwood CSM)
- Decision gate — Pilot readout + procurement sign-off: 2027-05-20 (owner: HyperBridge execs)

Stakeholders (as discussed):
- HyperBridge: Santiago Ruiz (product lead), Carmen Ortega (sec/infosec, intro pending), Procurement (procurement@hyperbridge.io)
- Redwood: Olga Petrov (AE), Ben Carter (SE), Jasmine Liu (CSM)

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Santiago: confirm Milestone A scope and share a sample of the busy-hour trace by EOD 2027-04-05.
- Ben & Jasmine: I’ll need an estimated Dedicated config and rough pricing for the 4-week baseline by 2027-04-07.
- I will attach a one-page MAP (initial) and a HubSpot link to the deal — if this looks right I can update and formalize.

Attachment: HyperBridge-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft — milestones, owners, deliverables).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Olga — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A couple clarifications: 

1) For Milestone A we can share a sanitized busy-hour trace (no PII) by COB 2027-04-06; Carmen is looping in security but she won’t be available until next week.
2) For the procurement decision gate we expect a procurement review first week of May; if the pilot shows the latency improvement and cost estimate looks reasonable, we should be able to fast-track to signature mid-May.

One ask: can Ben highlight what the minimal Dedicated footprint looks like to cover our 10k concurrent user bursts? That’ll help procurement with the cost modeling.

I’ll confirm the internal stakeholders list and introduce Carmen to the thread next week.

—Santiago
